scripts.text:
[Crewman]
Hey, have you heard of a place called Brasilis?
It's a tropical city that's hot like the desert but also rainy. It is a very mysterious place.
scripts.translation:
[船員]
嘿，聽說過巴西嗎？
那是座熱帶城市，像沙漠一樣炎熱，雨水卻很多，是個神秘的地方。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
We recently found a new ocean route to get there easily.
It's just 10,000 zeny for a round trip, and 1,000 for VIP! So do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[船員]
我們最近發現了一條通往那裡的新航線，非常方便。
往返只要10,000 Zeny，VIP只要1,000 Zeny！你想去嗎？

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
We recently found a new ocean route to get there easily.
It's just 10,000 zeny for a round trip! So do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[船員]
我們最近發現了一條通往那裡的新航線，非常方便。
往返只要10,000 Zeny！你想去嗎？

scripts.text: Take me to Brasilis!
scripts.translation: 帶我去巴西！

scripts.text: I'll stay here.
scripts.translation: 留在這裡

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
I said {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[船員]
我說了是{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
Cool~!! Let's go~!
scripts.translation:
[船員]
好耶~！我們出發吧~！

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
Well if you're ever interested, let me know and I can take you there.
scripts.translation:
[船員]
如果你以後想去的話，告訴我一聲，我可以帶你去。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
My ship is going to back to Alberta, do you want to join us?
scripts.translation:
[船員]
我的船要回艾爾貝塔了，你要一起嗎？

scripts.text: Go back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 返回艾爾貝塔

scripts.text: Not yet~.
scripts.translation: 再待一會兒

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
I sure do miss home.
scripts.translation:
[船員]
我真的很想念家鄉。

scripts.text:
[Crewman]
Ok, suit yourself. We'll see you when we get back then.
scripts.translation:
[船員]
好吧，隨你。
等我們回來再見。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Come~come~
Ice cream is the perfect snack for a hot day~
It's just ^3355FF100 Zeny^000000~
Ice Cream~
Get 'yer Ice Cream!
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
來~來~
大熱天，吃冰淇淋最合適啦~
只要^3355FF100 Zeny^000000~
冰淇淋~快來買冰淇淋！

scripts.text: Give me one!
scripts.translation: 來一個

scripts.text: Ice Cream?
scripts.translation: 冰淇淋是什麼

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Since there are so many people want to get a cool ice cream you can order only 5 at a time.
So how many d'ya want?
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
想吃清涼冰淇淋的人太多，一次最多買5個。
你要幾個？

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
None?
Fine get outta the way, I have customers to serve.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
不要？
好吧，讓開點，我還有別的顧客要招待。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Wow.
You ordered too much.
If you eat over 5 you might need to fight with a monster in your stomach. Calm down buddy.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
哇，你買得太多了。
吃超過5個，肚子裡可要鬧翻天了。
悠著點，朋友。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Dood~! You don't have enough money.
It's only ^3355FF100 Zeny^000000~ Seriously!
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
喂~！你的錢不夠。
只要^3355FF100 Zeny^000000啊~真的！

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
You seem to have too much stuff.
Lighten your pack before buying this.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
你帶的東西太多了。
先減輕負重，再來買吧。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
'Ice cream is...
Wait, don't you know
what Ice Cream is?
What rock have you
been living under?
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
冰淇淋就是...
等等，你不知道冰淇淋是什麼？
你也太孤陋寡聞了吧？

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
I'm not going to even start with how weird that sounds.
Anyway, get 'yer Ice Cream right here while it's nice and cold.
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
我都懶得說這有多奇怪了。
總之，趁冰淇淋還冰涼，趕快來買吧。

scripts.text:
[Ice Cream Maker]
Don't miss your chance to eat the greatest Ice Cream in all the land~!
scripts.translation:
[冰淇淋師]
別錯過品嚐全大陸最棒冰淇淋的機會~！
